title: Grateful Dead Live at Euphoria Ballroom on 1970-07-16
lineage: Cassette (Sony TC-WE475) -> Sony R500 (Pass Through) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard transfer captures a historic Janis‑Joplin guest spot on Lovelight and a soaring Candyman, delivering an electrifying show.
ai_review.review: The Charlie Miller analog‑to‑digital transfer provides crystal‑clear sound that lets listeners hear every nuance of the night, from Jerry’s spontaneous “Aw Fuck!” banter to Ron “Pigpen” growling his lines.  Janis Joplin’s surprise appearance on Lovelight and Candyman is repeatedly highlighted as a once‑in‑a‑lifetime moment, making the performance feel both historic and intensely vivid.

ai_rating.rationale: Multiple detailed reviews praise both the musical performance (guest appearance, standout songs) and the high‑quality soundboard transfer; overall enthusiasm translates to a top‑tier rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Charlie Miller’s analog‑to‑digital transfer is described as crisp, clear and faithful to the original tape; no dropouts or muddiness are reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows naturally into a historic guest spot, with Janis Joplin joining for Lovelight and Candyman; the energy is high throughout and the stage banter adds to the excitement.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry’s quick‑fire stage comment before Lovelight (“Aw Fuck!”) is noted; no specific guitar commentary but his presence energizes the moment.
